title: History and search · Phase 2.2
description: Rename, pin and archive conversations, reopen archived chats, and search downloaded message text.
notes: Phase 2.2 adds native history management and search.
Rename, pin or archive a conversation from its history menu. Earlier versions stay together, and archived conversations remain available from Archived chats.
Search titles and downloaded message text, including earlier conversation versions, with pinned and archived filters. Message search includes chats opened on this iPhone.

Metadata changes save locally and sync field by field, preserving unrelated web settings and newer queued changes. Durable operation markers prevent completed mutations being replayed after a failed local acknowledgement.
